findings.description: Desktop heading column 2 persists at the mobile breakpoint, creating an implicit grid column; photo, meta, route and description in column 1 collapse. At 390 px the computed tracks were 0px 346px and the first card was 970.09px tall.
findings.suggestion: Reset the h3 desktop grid-column assignment with matching specificity in the mobile rule; then verify each child has usable width.

findings.description: The 16px hero eyebrow sits over the pale river film at desktop y473..499. Adjacent pixels at source playback 3s measured approximately RGB 160/150/149, giving 2.5..2.7:1 contrast against the paper text. Lower paragraph had approximately 8.4:1.
findings.suggestion: Strengthen a localized overlay behind the eyebrow and first headline line while preserving scenic brightness elsewhere.

findings.description: Atlas footer renders Have somewhere else in mind?Tell us about it. without a visible separation; at 320 px the link wraps awkwardly.
findings.suggestion: Separate the helper sentence and link with a small gap or deliberate mobile line break.

passed_observations: No document horizontal overflow at 1440, 390 or 320 px.
Correct desktop or portrait film loads and plays at every reviewed width; no page errors.
Large hero and section typography fit at 320 px.
Rounded hero, atlas image, Kashi image, planner and footer consistently render.
Kashi four-day section, planner controls and footer remain readable at 320 px.
Homepage finder applies destination/category and presents the expected useful empty state for Ayodhya plus Buddhist trails.
scope_notes: Root and another agent were actively changing copy/routes during captures, so these are first-look observations rather than a frozen release audit.

Section-element screenshots include fixed-header and translated skip-link artifacts caused by screenshot clipping. Do not treat those composite positions as live layout defects. Hero/viewport captures show actual browser composition.
Footer credits intentionally omitted following latest explicit no-credits instruction; not a defect.
Search-index page checked separately in search-review.json, including seven-route/eight-destination reset count15.

cleanup.retained: Requested PNG visual evidence and JSON report only. Browser contexts closed. No disposable task files identified.
